prompt: From the hill in Greenwich Park at dusk, past a camp of tents and a brazier in the foreground with people wrapped in blankets watching: across the river the cluster of glass towers on the Isle of Dogs glows warm and fully lit, cranes still building another one. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
